purpose: Additional small-bed version of the RF03 relieved 24 mm collar. Preserve both original RF03 forms and their packages.
owner_request: Reduce the outer face by half around the unchanged relieved collar; keep locating screw tabs and original design. The annotated circular boundary is conceptual, not a measured dimension.

interpretation.rule: Halve the minimum radial face width outside the collar, keeping a circular outside edge. This is not half the whole diameter or half the face area.
interpretation.calculation: D_new = 145.10 + (240 - 145.10) / 2 = 192.55 mm. The smaller diameter is a design choice, not a measured requirement.

print.orientation: Files are pre-oriented: flat front face and tabs on bed Z=0; collar grows upward. No machine G-code supplied.
print.selection: Take original and small alternate; print one selected geometry. STL, 3MF and STEP are alternative formats of the same part. Do not scale to fit a smaller bed.

use.guidance: Collar still defines the same central keep-clear boundary. The smaller front face guides a smaller surrounding repair area. Outside its edge, establish flushness to sound tile separately with a straightedge or appropriate additional temporary form.
use.retention: Slots give coarse alignment and play, not precise centering or structural support. Remove rod-end nuts for insertion. Independent padded bracing supports the form; do not tighten nuts to load tabs or pull a distorted face flat.
use.repair: Rehearse seating, bracing and withdrawal before applying a compatible supported repair. Do not bridge an unsupported void or encase valve/service parts. Rear repair stays within the continuous front 12 mm collar zone.
use.removal: Temporary tool only. Remove form, release film and pads after suitable cure. This is not the permanent escutcheon or a waterproof liner.
use.physical_checks: Full-face bearing, hidden clearances, print strength, release and actual repair suitability are unverified. No new owner measurements requested.

capture_scope: No new registration or scan fit claim. New solid is strictly a subset of RF03 after reversing its print-position translation; collar, tabs and slots are verified unchanged. RF03 captured-scope limits continue to apply.
cost: Less CAD material than original; actual filament/time require friend's slicer. Prior $75 planning allowance covered one selected form plus one retry, not a promise of labor cost for printing every alternative.
